pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

4. Which response best shows understanding of Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah.
   D. Say Surah has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Eid? (1 mark)
   A. Use Eid to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Eid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Eid.
   D. Say Eid has no place in daily life.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

9. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Toileting? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Toileting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Toileting.
   C. Say Toileting has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Toileting to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Allah has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Belief in Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   B. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Toileting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. C — Apply the teaching of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

4. B — Apply the teaching of Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. B — Apply the teaching of Eid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

9. C — Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of Toileting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. D — Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islamic; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Relationship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
